```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# install.packages("factoextra")
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cluster)
library(ggplot2)
library(factoextra)
library(knitr)
```

###from previous nrc sentiments, the most common emotions were trust(mother, food), fear( hunting, jaws ), anger (droping positive and negative)


```{r}
if (!exists("fw_nrc" )){
  load(here("data/fw_nrc.rda"))
}
if (!exists("finn_clean" )){
  load(here("data/finn_clean.rda"))
}

fw_nrc$title_short <- paste("Ch", fw_nrc$chapter)

title_translate <- fw_nrc |> 
  group_by(chapter, title_short) |> 
  summarize(n_tokens = n(), .groups = "drop")

max(fw_nrc$chapter, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# inspiration from professor, creating an emotional matrix baased on top emotions 
nrc_wide <- fw_nrc |>
  
  filter(!sentiment %in% c("positive", "negative")) |>
  
  # Count how many of each emotion appear in each chapter
  count(chapter, sentiment) |>
  
  # Calculate the percentage of each emotion per chapter
  group_by(chapter) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  select(-n) |>
  
  # PIVOT WIDER: This creates the actual matrix!
  pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = prop, values_fill = 0) |>
  as.data.frame()

rownames(nrc_wide) <- paste("Chapter", nrc_wide$chapter)
nrc_wide <- nrc_wide |> select(-chapter)

# Take a peek at your beautiful new matrix!
(nrc_wide)
```
### some insight on the top sentiments and how they progress over the chapters. 
```{r}
finn_dist <- dist(nrc_wide, method = "euclidean")

# What is the optimal number of clusters?
fviz_nbclust(nrc_wide, pam, method = "silhouette") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Optimal Number of Clusters for Finn's Emotions")

finn_clusters <- pam(nrc_wide, k = 3, metric = "euclidean", stand = FALSE)

# 2. Visualize the clusters

fviz_cluster(finn_clusters,
             ellipse.type = "t",
             repel = TRUE,
             ggtheme = theme_classic(),
             main = "Emotional Clusters of Chapters")
```
